versions.changelog:
- Initial release with Instapaper import functionality.
- Parses Instapaper export: extracts article title, URL, and user's notes (skipping original highlights).
- Previews parsed notes and requests user confirmation before import.
- Creates a new slipbox entry for each note, using slipbot with proper metadata.
- Handles edge cases (no notes, multiline notes, special characters in titles).
